newsitem.title: FRANCE: SBC Warburg rates Roussel Uclaf neutral.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg rates Roussel Uclaf neutral.

text.p: SBC-Warburg lowered its recommendation on Roussel Uclaf to neutral from buy because it considered the share was correctly valued, market sources said on Wednesday.
Warburg also confirmed its buy recommendation on Rhone-Poulenc Rorer because of encouraging clinical tests on two of its drugs, the sources said.
Roussel shares closed down 3.48 percent at 1,332 francs while Rorer shares were up 1-7/8 at 70-3/8 at 1744 GMT on the New York Stock Exchange.
Roussel shares had gained about 24 percent since August 22.
